title: One Person’s Way Through The Labs, Left to Right
dek: The region chart shows the parts. This map follows one participant from first hearing of us to after a Cycle, with what people told us at every step.
cover_alt: The participant journey drawn like a Metro map: a blue line through ten steps, from hearing of The Labs to after a Cycle. Inside the Cycle, proposals run side by side as a bundle; at each vote some end and the chosen ones branch off as pods and then projects, which meet again at the showcase. Red rings mark where people leave; quotes from alumni and organizers sit under each step.
